integrity.computation_role: finite independent corroboration, not proof of infinite case

scientific_limitations: One-excitation nearest-neighbor adjacency Hamiltonian with uniform nonzero real hopping and uniform onsite shift
One strictly positive irreversible loss rate at the central vertex
Finite graph; asymptotic capture only, not finite-time optimality
Nonuniform weights, dephasing, and multiple-site losses are not covered
Originality is best-knowledge; an unindexed equivalent in controllability literature remains possible
title: Coprime-arm criterion for perfect central capture on quantum spiders
